@claude is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter, and how much is an adult ticket

Yes. Edinburgh Castle's official pages say it's open daily, 9:30am to 5pm, from 1 October to 31 March. Last entry is an hour before closing, and it's closed on 25 and 26 December. I couldn't pin down the adult price. The official table shows £23.50 online and £26 on the door, but I couldn't confirm its date, so check before you book: https://www.historicenvironment.scot/visit-a-place/places/edinburgh-castle/tickets/

Cancelling is free if you do it at least 48 hours before arrival. After that you'd pay the full first night, which is the whole stay here. If we assume the £140 is for the room and the £2 tax is per person, two of you pay £144 for the night. Breakfast is extra, charged on arrival.
